title: mad'he shabbir me jab uthaaya qalam
body:
mad'he shabbir me jab uthaaya qalam, kya bataau ke kya kya mila dosto
ban gaya lafz nehjul balagha koi , koi quraab se ja mila dosto
<<DIVIDER>>
aaj har chashme nam me ye tehreer hai, qisr dil me bapa jashne shabbir hai
apni palko pe ashko ki shamme lie, har koi muskurata mila dosto
<<DIVIDER>>
gar teherjaata shabbir ka qafela , kaabe ki qaak ho jaati qaake shifa
qaake karbobala ki ye taqdeer thi, karbala ko ye rutba mila dosto
<<DIVIDER>>
mutmain nafs ka wo jo haamil hua, jiski marzi ka taalib hua hai quda
poori tareeq me juz shahe karbala, kya koi aisa banda mila dosto
<<DIVIDER>>
behre sajda jhukaaya tha jo qaak par, apni marzi se phir na uthaaya wo sar
wo jo jaari rahega qayamat talak, kya koi aisa sajda mila dosto
<<DIVIDER>>
naam likkha jo kaaghaz pe abbas ka , naqsh ubharne laga sabr ka pyaas ka
karke darya pe qabza jo pyaasa raha, ek aisa bhi saqqa mila dosto
<<DIVIDER>>
tum jo kehte rahe ya quda ya quda, hum bhi kehte rahe ya ali murtaza
tumko kaafa mila sirf kaaba mila, hamko mouloode kaaba mila dosto
<<DIVIDER>>
ham gunahgaar hai ham qatawaar hai, par shahe karbala ke azadar hai
jinke sadqe me fitrus ko par mil gaye, hur ko roomaale zahra mila dosto
